newsitem.title: ANGOLA: Thirty-seven die in Angolan Air Force crash - U.N.
newsitem.headline: Thirty-seven die in Angolan Air Force crash - U.N.

text.p: Thirty-seven people were killed when an Angolan Air Force plane crashed in UNITA-held territory in western Angola, the United Nations said on Wednesday.
The Angolan Air Force confirmed separately that a Casa 212 aircraft which had disappeared at the weekend had crashed in Bengo province near the town of Quiangala, and that there were no survivors.

The United Nations said the former rebel UNITA movement's troops had discovered the wreckage. The plane had taken off from Luanda on Saturday bound for the town of Cafunfo in northeastern Angola. No further details were available.
